skins.name: Default Outfit
skins.content:
A gown Exusiai designed for her own graduation ceremony.
The most eye-catching design paired with the most striking accessories. Before leaving Laterano, she wanted to give herself an extra-special ceremony.

skins.name: Default Outfit
skins.content:
She puts on this finery once more.
She has returned to Laterano. She has a new understanding of everything in the Holy City. She makes a new wish.
